availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Route 113/114 is reached after Mauville/Wattson (cap 30) via Route 111 -> Route 112 -> Fiery Path, per Game Book C20/C21. Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map the player has already passed on the way to Route 113/114: Seaspray Cave B1F (Sneasel), Rusturf Tunnel (Drilbur), Petalburg City Old Rod (Magikarp), Route 102 (Togepi), Mauville Game Corner (Litten), Granite Cave 1F (Abra). No Route 118+, Mt. Pyre, desert-interior or post-Flannery sources are used. Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly (C13); Gyaradosite stone window 20. Route 114 is reached from Fallarbor per Game Book C20/C21. Adds Petalburg Woods (Heracross gate 14, Heracronite window 14) and NewMauville_Entrance (Magnezone gate 30).
plan: Lucas is a complete snow formation: Snow Warning Ninetales sets the weather and Light Clay Aurora Veil, two Slush Rush attackers convert the speed, and Froslass is the disruption reserve. I have no weather setter to replace snow, so the plan is to remove the caster before the Veil goes up and then burn the Ice types down. Incineroar's Fake Out is priority and beats Ninetales's base 109 Speed, so turn one can deny Aurora Veil outright; Excadrill's Iron Head is 4x into Ice/Fairy Ninetales and Magnezone's Flash Cannon is the same. Every member of Lucas's team is 2x to Fire and Alolan Sandslash is 4x to both Fire and Fighting, so Incineroar and Mega Heracross cover the whole roster. Two things to respect: Slush Rush doubles Beartic's and Sandslash's Speed while snow is up, so my Speed reads are wrong from the moment the weather lands, and Froslass carries Destiny Bond, so I will not finish it with a Pokemon I cannot afford to trade.
